description: Orange-bellied Parrot observations allocated to ABS 2024 LGAs and pooled by calendar month. Boundary source: https://geo.abs.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/ASGS2024/LGA/MapServer/0 (ABS, CC BY 4.0); display geometry simplified approximately 200 m. All 2017–2026 observations use the same 2024 boundaries. Records lacking a usable date or coordinates, or outside the polygons, are excluded consistently. The default view is cropped around the recorded LGAs along southern mainland Australia and Tasmania, reducing the visible area of states without records while keeping all recorded LGA geometry in view. The State dropdown offers All regions and 3 recorded states; selecting a state filters the charts to that state and fits the map. Local government areas remain visible with tooltips and cannot be used as location filters. The line chart is a single unstacked series. Without a timeframe highlight, each calendar month shows average observations across distinct recorded years in the selected state, including zero months within those years. Map fills show the mean of the twelve monthly averages divided by LGA area, expressed per 1,000 km². With a month highlight, fills show pooled records in those months per 1,000 km². Areas are approximate spherical areas from the embedded simplified boundaries (mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m), independent of zoom. The colour scale uses a fixed all-period density maximum in count mode and its time-averaged equivalent in average mode. One collinear island triangle introduced by coordinate rounding in Circular Head is omitted to avoid a globe-spanning geometry artefact. Draw a highlight for raw counts, drag its body to move it, or resize either edge. Double-click or Show averages restores the average view. Reset view fits the selected state without changing filters. Counts are observation records, not bird abundance. State backdrop: https://github.com/rowanhogan/australian-states. Uses the 10 most recent available years in Dataset/orange_bellied_parrot_cleaned.csv (2017–2026), including partial 2026. Embedded year-month allocations and pooled monthly counts both use this window. State options include only states with mapped records in this window. Local government areas are areas managed by local councils. Grey means no records in the selected timeframe or missing LGA data (including land outside the eight embedded council boundaries). It does not indicate that birds are absent; tooltips distinguish zero records from missing data.

title.text: How do parrot records vary through the year?
subtitle: Orange-bellied Parrot · Records per 1,000 km² of council area · 2017–2026

transform.expr: isValid(datum.total) && isFinite(datum.areaM2) && datum.areaM2 > 0 ? datum.total * 1e9 / datum.areaM2 : null
isValid(datum.count) && isFinite(datum.areaM2) && datum.areaM2 > 0 ? datum.count * 1e9 / datum.areaM2 : null

tooltip.signal: {'State': datum.properties.STATE_NAME, 'Data status': 'Missing data: council-area detail is not included here', 'Meaning': 'No record density is available; this does not mean zero records or no birds'}

{'Council area (local government area)': datum.region, 'State': datum.state, 'Timeframe': brushRange ? periodLabel : 'All calendar months', 'Data status': !isValid(datum.density) ? 'Missing data' : datum.count == 0 ? 'No records in this timeframe (birds may still be present)' : 'Records available', 'Records per 1,000 km²': isValid(datum.density) ? format(datum.density, ',.3~f') : 'Missing data', 'Council area (km², approximate)': format(datum.areaM2 / 1e6, ',.1f'), 'Observation records': isValid(datum.count) ? format(datum.count, brushRange ? ',d' : ',.3f') : 'Missing data', 'Measure': brushRange ? 'Pooled records in selected months per 1,000 km²' : 'Monthly average per recorded year per 1,000 km²', 'Recorded years': recordedYearCount}

text.signal: (brushRange ? 'Monthly observation counts · ' : 'Average observations by calendar month · ') + regionLabel

tooltip.signal: {'Location': regionLabel, 'Month': datum.monthLabel, 'Value': format(datum.count, brushRange ? ',d' : ',.2f'), 'Measure': brushRange ? 'Observation count' : 'Average observations per recorded year'}

text.signal: brushRange ? 'Records per 1,000 km² · selected months' : 'Average monthly records per 1,000 km²'

normalization.areaMethod: Spherical area of embedded simplified LGA geometry; mean Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m
normalization.highlightMode: count = pooled records in selected calendar months
normalization.interpretation: Observation record density; does not adjust for survey effort or estimate bird abundance
normalization.missingData: Null counts or invalid areas have no density. State backdrop has no embedded council-area detail; explicit zero counts mean no records in the selected timeframe.
